name: To Handle EnterPage
text:
system logical __import
	system lastbook
	system nextpage

	lastbook = name of this book
	nextpage = "p10"
	if  __import = false  then
		if sysLevel = "reader"  then
			go to page "P0" of book getLogoBook()
		else
			if  __beenToP1 of this book = false  then
				__beenToP1 of this book = true
				if  isObject(page "P1")  then
					go to page "P1"
				end if
			end if
		end if
	end if
end

To ???????Reader
	forward
	send enterpage to self
end
